scope: Single source receiver m1-natural, complete three-view PAMF with reference response, seeds 2026092701/02/03. Main split excluded. Existing target data and prior results are exposed, so this is development evidence.
evaluation: Freeze all six candidate predictions before independent truth-last scores. Each m1-natural same-packet test: clean and six practical scenes; DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; cross_date separately from the cross_rx/cross_both combined population. Report each seed, scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No leo_weak or target-driven model selection/reruns.
success: Aim to exceed PL by more than 2 percentage points in clean and every practical DURA-LU scene and exceed original Tri; report all seed/scenario negatives, and do not generalize from this exposed setting.
expected_artifacts: Six true E20 parent, no-query smoke checks
Six E30/E50 fixed continuation sources and actual SSL counters
Six frozen seven-scene predictions followed by independent matched three-seed and subgroup scores
